summary: Iteration 73 - Tested multi-tenant syndic_id isolation and deduplication features (Steps E & F). Fixed 4 critical bugs: 1) UnboundLocalError in suppliers.py (assign_supplier_account shadowing), 2) NameError in properties.py (syndic_query undefined in update_owner), 3) Missing syndic_query imports in suppliers.py (bce_candidates, update_supplier, delete_supplier, merge_suppliers), 4) Missing syndic_query import in properties.py (attach_owner_to_copro). Backend tests: 20 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend tests: Login, Owners page, Suppliers page all working correctly.

critical.issue: NameError: 'request' is not defined at lines 2567, 2596, 2664 in properties.py. The inject_syndic() calls use 'request' but mutate_lot function doesn't have request parameter.

action_items: Fix mutate_lot function in properties.py - add 'request: Request' parameter and pass it to inject_syndic() calls at lines 2567, 2596, 2664. Alternatively, use get_syndic_id_for_copro(db, copro_id) to get syndic_id without request.
critical_code_review_comments: properties.py:2567,2596,2664 - inject_syndic(entry, request) uses undefined 'request' variable in mutate_lot function
The massive sed/regex refactoring to inject syndic_id missed adding the request parameter to mutate_lot function signature

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, owners page, suppliers page all working)

seed_data_creation: Test owners and suppliers created during tests are cleaned up automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: The mutate_lot function in properties.py has a bug where 'request' is undefined. This affects lot mutation operations. All other CRUD operations for owners and suppliers are working correctly. The BCE duplicate warning component exists in SuppliersPage.js at line 342 with data-testid='bce-duplicate-warning'. Auth uses cookies (not Bearer tokens).

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: During the massive sed/regex refactoring to inject syndic_id into all backend routes, the mutate_lot function was modified to call inject_syndic(entry, request) but the function signature was not updated to include 'request: Request' parameter.
reproduction_steps: 2. Navigate to a lot detail page
3. Try to mutate (sell) the lot to a new owner
4. Backend will crash with NameError: name 'request' is not defined
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Add 'request: Request' parameter to mutate_lot function signature at line 2266 in properties.py, or use get_syndic_id_for_copro(db, copro_id) helper function instead of inject_syndic()
